full_prompt_en: A square expressionist painting places two solemn men before a loosely assembled coastal town and harbor. The nearer man stands on the right in a white shirt, narrow dark tie, charcoal vest and dark trousers. His elongated yellow-ochre face has large pale eyes rimmed with brown, a sharp nose and a fixed forward gaze. Slightly behind him at the center stands a thinner man in a dark jacket, his smaller face similarly long and watchful. Their upright bodies form two still vertical marks against a landscape of unstable color. Across the left half, tiny dark figures gather along a pale wall and sloping ground; a bright yellow boat shape rises from the lower-left corner amid blue and rust-colored strokes. Near the center, a narrow doorway and steps lead toward a white building on the distant rise. A thin chimney releases dark smoke into the cool blue sky, while a pale round glow hangs at the upper left. The shoreline, buildings and ground are fragmented into rough patches of teal, ochre, burnt orange, gray and cream. Brush marks remain visible and often cross the edges of objects, so the setting feels as restless as the men are rigid. Light is diffuse, with the pale building and men's faces carrying the highest values; yellow highlights vibrate against the surrounding blue, without a single hard cast shadow. The overall composition joins a crowded, tilted landscape to two frontal figures, creating an uneasy balance of weathered color and direct human stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现主义绘画把两名神情肃穆的男子置于松散拼合的海边城镇与港口前。较近的男子站在右侧，穿白衬衫、窄深色领带、炭黑背心和深色长裤。他拉长的黄赭色脸上有棕色眼圈环绕的浅色大眼、锐利鼻梁与固定的正面目光。中央稍后方站着一名更瘦的男子，穿深色外套，较小的脸同样细长而警觉。两人直立的身体成为不稳定色彩景观前两道静止竖痕。左半边，一群深色小人影聚在浅色墙与倾斜地面旁；亮黄小船形从左下角的蓝与锈色笔痕中升起。中央附近，一道窄门和台阶通向远处高地上的白色建筑。细烟囱把暗烟送入冷蓝天空，左上方悬着一个浅色圆光。海岸、建筑与地面被拆成青蓝、赭色、焦橙、灰与奶油色的粗糙色块。笔痕清晰可见，且常跨越物体边缘，让背景如同男子的僵直身姿一样令人不安。光线漫射，浅色建筑与男子面部占据最高明度；黄色高光在周围蓝色中振动，却没有单一强硬的投影。整体构图把拥挤、倾斜的景观与两名正面人物连接起来，以饱经风霜的色彩和直面观者的人物静止感形成不安的平衡。
style_prompt_en: An expressionist painted surface builds forms from broken, visibly worked patches of teal blue, yellow ochre, burnt orange, chalky cream and charcoal. Elongated vertical shapes carry a tense stillness while surrounding planes tilt, overlap and dissolve into short rough strokes. Dark sketchlike lines appear intermittently rather than enclosing every edge; pale areas are scraped or brushed thin so underlying color remains active. Large color contrasts supply depth more than conventional perspective or smooth shading. Diffuse light lifts a few cream and yellow planes out of the cool blue field, with little hard cast shadow. Dense activity near the lower margin gives way to broad, weathered color above. The visual effect is uneasy and poetic, its emotional force coming from fractured surfaces and unequal scales.
style_prompt_zh: 表现主义绘画表面由青蓝、黄赭、焦橙、粉笔般奶油白和炭黑的破碎、明显反复加工的色块构成形体。拉长的竖向形状带有紧张的静止感，周围色面却倾斜、重叠，并散成短促粗糙的笔划。深色速写线间歇出现，而非封闭每一条边；浅色区域刮薄或薄刷，让底层颜色仍然活跃。大面积色彩对比比常规透视或平滑明暗更能提供纵深。漫射光从冷蓝色域中提起少数奶油白与黄色色面，几乎没有硬投影。下缘附近密集的活动向上过渡为宽阔、磨旧的色彩。视觉效果不安而诗意，情绪力量来自破碎表面与不均衡的尺度。
theme_en: Two solemn men before a turbulent coastal town in an expressive painted scene
theme_zh: 表现性绘画中，两名神情肃穆的男子站在动荡的海边城镇前
name: John Bellany
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
